purpose: Determine whether the E3H-A2 O14 tau-floor collapse is a local solver/bound artifact or evidence that an isolated top-node h=0 event requires a different near-saturation event topology. This is reference-only diagnosis, not Ross candidate qualification.

upstream.A2_O14_observation: All 24 frozen profile x supply cases collapse to tau approximately 1e-8 d; drier profiles increase the unresolved balance residual.

event_equations.reuse: Exact E3H-A event residual: h0 fixed at 0 cm; three conservative cell balances plus exact surface-storage balance; bottom head unchanged at -15 cm.

only_diagnostic_scope_change.meaning: Allow h1 and h2 to enter the already characterized near-saturation region while retaining negative head. No positive lower-node head is allowed.

deterministic_multistart.bounded_cost_note: A3 is qualification-only diagnostic scratch; this cost is not a production candidate cost claim.

reproducibility.multiple_distinct_clusters: Record all; do not select one silently.

topology_classification.NO_REPRODUCIBLE_REFERENCE_ROOT: No cluster satisfies the frozen validity and reproducibility rules.

decision_logic.isolated_root_found: A2 O14 failure is primarily fixture-solver/bound related; next gate may investigate isolated-event solver policy without changing physics.
decision_logic.near_saturation_root_found: The intended event is not isolated under the frozen O14 cases; next gate must characterize the corresponding multi-node/near-saturation event topology.
decision_logic.no_root_found: Do not lower tau floor or extend the A2 grid. Investigate whether the event condition itself must be reformulated as a coupled complementarity/co-event problem.

hard_guards: Do not alter the 24 A2 O14 profile x supply cases.
Do not lower the 1e-8 d event-time floor.
Do not enlarge the 1 cm surface-storage/head scope.
Do not run or modify the Ross candidate in A3.
Do not treat a single-start least-squares solution as physical evidence.
Do not introduce positive h1/h2 in this diagnostic.
Do not qualify production behavior from A3.

architecture_checks.transactionality: Committed state is immutable throughout all diagnostic trials.
architecture_checks.mass_conservation: Only roots satisfying the unchanged 1e-9 cm conservative residual gate are evidence.
architecture_checks.physics_solver_policy_separation: A3 changes only diagnostic bounds and starting guesses; physical equations, material parameters and forcing cases are unchanged.
architecture_checks.bounded_cost: 12 fixed starts x 24 fixed cases; no adaptive case generation.
